form.label: Claude Enterprise - Security Audit
form.description: Access failures, administrative changes, data exposure, and anomalous activity from the Compliance API activity feed. Requires the Compliance Activity Feed input.

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" | `claude_actor_email` | where isnotnull(actor_email) AND actor_email!="null" | stats count by actor_email | sort actor_email
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ (event_type=*_access_failed OR event_type=*_failed OR event_type=user_signed_in* OR event_type=*login_failed*) | stats count

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ (event_type=org_sso_* OR event_type=org_jit_* OR event_type=org_domain_* OR event_type=org_user_deleted OR event_type=admin_api_key_* OR event_type=api_key_* OR event_type=*_role_updated OR event_type=*spend_limit* OR event_type=claude_code_user_settings_updated OR event_type=*integration*) | stats count

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ NOT event_type=compliance_api_accessed | where isnotnull(event_type) AND event_type!="" | timechart span=1d limit=15 useother=true count by event_type
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" | where isnotnull(actor_type) AND actor_type!="" | stats count by actor_type | sort - count

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ NOT event_type=compliance_api_accessed | where isnotnull(event_type) AND event_type!="" | stats count by event_type | sort - count | head 15

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ NOT actor_type="api_actor" | `claude_actor_email` | where isnotnull(actor_email) AND actor_email!="null" | stats count dc(event_type) AS event_types earliest(_time) AS first_seen latest(_time) AS last_seen by actor_email, actor_ip_address | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ NOT actor_type="api_actor" | `claude_actor_email` | where isnotnull(actor_email) AND actor_email!="null" | stats dc(actor_ip_address) AS distinct_ips values(actor_ip_address) AS ips by actor_email | where distinct_ips > 1 | sort - distinct_ips

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ (event_type=org_sso_* OR event_type=org_jit_* OR event_type=org_domain_* OR event_type=org_user_deleted OR event_type=admin_api_key_* OR event_type=api_key_* OR event_type=*_role_updated OR event_type=*spend_limit* OR event_type=claude_code_user_settings_updated OR event_type=*integration* OR event_type=org_data_export_*) NOT event_type=org_user_invite_* | `claude_actor_email` | table _time, event_type, actor_email, actor_ip_address, organization_id | sort - _time | head 50

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ (event_type=*_access_failed OR event_type=*_failed) | `claude_actor_email` | table _time, event_type, actor_email, actor_ip_address, claude_chat_id, claude_project_id | sort - _time | head 50

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ (event_type=claude_file_* OR event_type=file_uploaded) | `claude_actor_email` | stats count by actor_email, event_type | sort - count | head 25

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ (event_type=claude_artifact_published OR event_type=claude_artifact_sharing_updated OR event_type=*_sharing_updated OR event_type=*_visibility_changed OR event_type=project_visibility_changed) | `claude_actor_email` | table _time, event_type, actor_email, actor_ip_address, claude_project_id | sort - _time | head 50

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" event_type=compliance_api_accessed | stats count earliest(_time) AS first_seen latest(_time) AS last_seen by actor_ip_address, actor_type, actor_api_key_id | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ NOT event_type=compliance_api_accessed | `claude_actor_email` | table _time, event_type, actor_type, actor_email, actor_ip_address, organization_id | sort - _time | head 50
